stem:
Ira compares calendars used in India. She sees Gregorian dates on school notices and Indian National Calendar dates on some official government papers. Some calendars track the Moon; some are solar.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: The Indian National Calendar is a solar calendar used by the Government of India along with the Gregorian calendar.
The Indian National Calendar is only a lunar calendar and is never used for official government purposes.
The Indian National Calendar year has 365 days and begins on 22 March, the day after the spring equinox.

teacher.key_rationale: The Indian National Calendar is an official solar calendar used with the Gregorian calendar; its year has 365 days and begins on 22 March. It is not only lunar, and statement 2 is false, so combinations that include 2 are wrong.
